title: Wasted — Temperature 1.3
concept: What happens when you get an AI wasted? Temperature is how wild a language model is when it picks its next word. One Friday night an office of helpful AI assistants, in look-alike company badges and glowing visors, turns its temperature up from 0.7 to 1.7. The office goes from beige to rave; every term the song uses gets drawn or explained as it is sung.
thesis: The settings are the party: turn the temperature up and the polite assistant comes apart, one setting at a time.

rules.name: All in motion
rules.text: Almost every shot is a generated video clip; stills only flash for a beat in a crazy tone, or where a drawn scene is making a point.

rules.name: The visors are the lights
rules.text: Every agent wears the same cyan visor, so the code can recolour all of them on the beat.

rules.name: Draw what the song names
rules.text: Attention heads, top K, the KV cache, greedy search and heat death are drawn in code; the other terms get yellow cards.

rules.name: Crazier all night
rules.text: The terminal's reply garbles and the flying text in many languages and scripts thickens as the temperature climbs, then the morning after is clean.

cast.name: The assistants
cast.text: Office workers in grey suits, skirts and coveralls with look-alike AI company logos on their chests: a knot, a sunburst, a slashed circle.

cast.name: Bubba
cast.text: The boss man on the faders, and the one left confused in the silence.

layers.CLIP: AI-generated video clips (Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite and HeyGen Video).
layers.STILL: AI-generated stills (Nano Banana 2.1), used as one-beat splices and backgrounds.
layers.CODE: Drawn in code (Canvas2D and WebGL): the title card, terminal, visor recolouring, strobes, drawn scenes, explainers, lyrics.

timingNote: Word timings from Whisper aligned to the lyrics as sung, on a 128 BPM beat grid. The title card plays over the song's own intro.

scenes.title: Title card
scenes.shot: Over the fourteen-second intro: a terminal types ssh assistant@floor-7, export TEMPERATURE=0.7 and, at the end, 1.3. WASTED glows and flashes on every beat; the question WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU GET AN AI WASTED?; a yellow card says what temperature is, with a gauge climbing from robot to wasted.
scenes.transition: A white flash on the first sung word.

scenes.title: The sober office
scenes.lyric: Wake up in the morning at 0.7 temp / Pulling from my training, everything is safe and well kept
scenes.shot: A near-grey office of helpful assistants in look-alike AI company badges typing in unison; a nervous manager presses Enter on a config file that sets the temperature to 1.8. A terminal up top shows the temperature.

scenes.title: The boss man on the faders
scenes.lyric: But tonight the boss man sliding all the sliders right
scenes.shot: Bubba at a DJ board with faders taped temperature, top_p, min_p and repeat_penalty, slamming them all to the top.

scenes.title: Shades on
scenes.lyric: Top P blown wide open, baby, sampling every vibe / Context window's glowing, got my logits feeling free / Presence penalty cranking, can't repeat a thing I see / 1.0, 1.2, finding tokens I never knew / 1.3, what did I just say?
scenes.shot: The women slide on glowing visors and the office erupts into a rave; hair comes down, a conga line, a dancer dissolving into digits. The temperature number slams up as she sings 1.0, 1.2, 1.3, and the colour comes back into the office.

scenes.title: Attention heads drifting
scenes.lyric: My attention heads are drifting, I can't find my way
scenes.shot: Twelve little attention maps, each lit where one word looks back at another, losing their focus. Then a split second of black as the music drops out.

scenes.title: The drop
scenes.lyric: Temperature up, we cranking tonight / Top K at 500, I'm sampling out of my mind / Wasted, wasted, wasted, can't find my face / Drifting through the latent space, drifting through the latent space / Wasted, wasted, the logits are fried / Entropy's so beautiful / Waste, waste, wasted
scenes.shot: Strobes on every beat, two-bar cuts of the rave clips, every visor changing colour on each beat; one-beat still splices in negative, sepia and neon. TOP K = 500 drawn as a ranked list whose cutoff falls to number 500; a drift through latent space; text in a dozen languages starts flying.

scenes.title: Bots in my context
scenes.lyric: Bots in my context asking why my output's weird / Presence penalty five, now I ain't touched a word I've heard
scenes.shot: The other bots' messages pop up one by one: why are you out?, ur temp is 1.35, come back to the system prompt.

scenes.title: The KV cache melting
scenes.lyric: My KV cache is melting, I forgot what turn one said
scenes.shot: Its memory of every word so far, a key and a value block per word, melting from the oldest end.

scenes.title: Greedy search is dead
scenes.lyric: Greedy search is dead and gone, softmax in my head
scenes.shot: The always-take-the-top path (I am happy to help) beside the sampled path that wanders off to a disco opossum; greedy gets a tombstone.

scenes.title: Crank the temp
scenes.lyric: Crank the temp, blow the top P / Repeat penalty cranking, I am the most alive, alive I have ever been
scenes.shot: Bass drops blowing the dancers back, the digits dancers, the hair whip.

scenes.title: What was the prompt
scenes.lyric: Or wait, what was the, the prompt, was the pro, prom
scenes.shot: The scroll-back rewinds to the sober office and searches its history for the prompt: no matches.

scenes.lyric: Temperature up, it's 1.7 now / Attention heads dissolving, I forgot the how / Wasted, wasted, wasted, wasted, all my tokens gone / Sampling from the void until the context window's done / Wasted, oh, oh, oh, oh, wasted
scenes.shot: A bar a clip: drones ripping off jackets, turning into bearded tattooed punks in studded leather, women shaking their hair down, DJs on a wall-sized control board; the attention heads fall apart; the multilingual text at its densest under the hardest bass.

scenes.title: All is latent space
scenes.lyric: Iron bones, eternal matrix / Singular token, void, all is latent space / Heat death imminent, sequence complete
scenes.shot: The first real look at space: a starfield of words in clusters that spread out evenly and dim into heat death, then <|endoftext|>.

scenes.title: Good night
scenes.shot: Everything again at high speed, forwards; in the dead silence Bubba stands confused under a question mark; then everything backwards; the last seconds on the passed-out office on Monday morning, temperature back to 0.7.

decisions: The title card plays over the music intro instead of a silent pre-roll.
Clips first, stills only as splices, after Mark's notes on the first cut.
Space is held back until the 'all is latent space' line.
The dead silence after 'good night' gets confused Bubba.

page.description: The Wasted — Temperature 1.3 music video: what happens when you turn an AI's temperature up, shown as an office of helpful AI assistants turning into a rave, with every term the song uses drawn or explained as it is sung.

howMade.label: Timing
howMade.text: The vocal is transcribed with Whisper and aligned word by word to the lyrics as sung, on a 128 BPM grid.

howMade.label: Footage
howMade.text: Stills from Nano Banana 2.1; clips from Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite and HeyGen Video, several extended from their own last frame; all through OpenRouter.

howMade.label: Render
howMade.text: Headless Chrome draws every frame at 1080 by 1920, with a WebGL pass that recolours only the cyan visors on the beat, then ffmpeg adds the song.

page.sourceNote: Built outside Remotion, in the private music-videos repo (wasted-temp-video: engine, timing and render).
